about: Nodes whose code is merged into apps/mcp/src/agent/graph/gatewayNodes.js but not wired into texConfig.json yet (Dev2, 2026-11-16: "for code changes, create the node inside the code first and merge it to main"). A shelf node never runs: the runner runs only the config's nodes. A Lab draft wires it, and Promote takes it off the shelf in the same pull request that puts it in the config. Each entry: the node's id, its files (repository paths), and what it is for.

handoff.why: Hands a job the front door could not finish inside its turn to a background worker (Dev2, 2026-11-18: the front door stays fast; a long or multi-step job is acknowledged at once and a worker with more rounds delivers it). Asked at two moments, each by its own wire, its input's cause saying which: fd -> handoff (uses) when the front door is two rounds from its bound and still calling tools (cause rounds), and answerCheck -> handoff (uses) when the Answer check would send a draft back and its send-back budget is spent (cause check). The job's brief is their ask, why it was handed on, the unsent words and what the turn already found; the person gets the job's start tapback and the worker's report. Unwired, nothing changes.
